comment: AlUla is a magical place where history meets nature. Every time I visit, I feel proud of our heritage.
The AlUla Oasis trail is so relaxing. Walking among the palm trees is the best way to clear your mind.
An open-air museum! The silence of the desert and the beauty of the Nabataean tombs are unlike anything else.
Watching the sunset at Elephant Rock was beautiful. It is a mystical place that everyone should visit once.
